body: Shungite is a black rock with a high carbon content. The commercial stone is quarried in Karelia, in north west Russia, and takes its name from the village of Shunga. That is a fact about the mineral rather than about this piece: the listing does not say where this one came from.
The piece is worked into a pyramid, 8 cm by 8 cm. The listing does not say whether that is base by height or two sides of the base.
One measurement, 8 cm by 8 cm, and a price. Everything else on the sheet below says not printed.
No weight, no finish, no grade word, no origin for this piece, no assay and no certificate.

acc.summary: What this page does not say
body: The listing this pyramid came from makes a number of statements about what it does and where to put it. None of them are repeated here, and none of them are made here in different words either.

The listing also carries the sentence that the product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. That sentence is an American one. It does not make the paragraphs above it lawful in Britain, so those paragraphs are not on this page.
Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday. UK delivery is free over £50, or you can collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

spec.label: Objects · 02
spec.intro: Two rows of this sheet are printed on the listing. The rest of it is a list of the things that are not.
spec.caption: Shungite Pyramid
rows: Makeup
Shungite, a black rock with a high carbon content. One piece, shaped into a pyramid.
Dimensions
8 cm × 8 cm, as printed. The listing does not say which of those is the base and which is the height.
Price
£28.99 for one pyramid. One size, and the listing offers no variants.
Weight
Not printed. The listing gives dimensions and no weight, which is the reverse of the stone on the same shelf.
Grade
Not printed. No grade word is used for this piece and no assay comes with it, so no carbon percentage appears here.
Finish
Not printed. The listing does not say whether the faces are polished or left matt.
Origin
Not printed for this piece. Shungite as a mineral is quarried in Karelia, north west Russia.
Certificate
None supplied. No assay, no laboratory report, no purity certificate.
Use
The listing prints a suggested placement. It cannot be separated from a claim we are not able to make, so it is not repeated here.
The disclaimer
The listing carries the sentence that the product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. It is an American sentence and it does not make the paragraphs above it lawful here.
Suitable for
Anybody. It is an object, not something you take.
Not for
It is not a food and it is not a supplement. Nothing on this page tells you to do anything with it.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: A shaped rock has two figures worth printing: how big it is and what it costs. Both are above. The listing this pyramid came from goes considerably further than that, and none of it has been carried across, in those words or in any others.

reiss.label: From Reiss
paras: The pyramid costs two pounds more than the loose stone and, as far as the listing goes, weighs nothing at all, because no weight is printed for it. What you are buying is a mineral and a shape. The sheet above is the whole of what I can tell you about either of them.

The listing ends with the sentence about not diagnosing or curing anything. I have kept that sentence on the sheet, because it is true, and left out the paragraphs above it, because those are the part that would have needed proving.
reiss.pull: A pyramid is a shape. It is not a specification.
